protocol: Freeze before GPU fit. Share one crop locator between arms: select one of nine overlapping half-width/height windows or a wider central view by constrained token on source and lettered previews. Map choice to original source pixels and execute the same real local description tool. Exclude already successful local boxes. Keep previous routing, teacher-forced 30 fit, 16 gate, 45 reused exploratory cases, and max four tool attempts. Once per fit case with a local reference, score the first predicted crop versus the reference clipped to source bounds, fixed central half-view, and best available view. On the same fit prefixes compare automatically judged answers before versus after the real local response. Report all eligible cases regardless of fit audit results. Gate on strictly improved tool-set F1 and nondecreasing answer count; deploy baseline on rejection but score raw candidate throughout. Separately score previously excluded search-reference cases with image-path overlap with prior panels removed: partial-tool stress only, search remains unavailable. Main outcome raw paired answer gains and losses on 45, plus regional successes, action F1 and average attempts. No image or task-level data released.
